scripts.setup: node scripts/setup-env.mjs && npm ci && docker compose up -d --build --wait && npm run db:deploy -w backend && npm run db:seed -w backend
scripts.dev: docker compose up -d --wait && concurrently --names api,worker,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev:worker -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
